subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should Node-originated `agent.request` attachments be allowed to cross into credentialed IM delivery automatically, and if so what explicit opt-in and safety semantics should be required?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the desired behavior changes a trust boundary and protocol contract; automation cannot choose whether the product should permit fallback media relay or keep agent-authored delivery only.

options.title: Approve explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Add a narrow `agent.request` opt-in with route authorization, MIME/size caps, duplicate suppression, audit/transcript receipts, and agent override or suppression rules.

options.title: Keep agent-authored delivery only
options.body: Leave Node attachments as model input and require the agent, message tool, or direct send surfaces to author any media sent to chat.

options.title: Defer to broader media relay design
options.body: Fold this into a host-owned media artifact relay design alongside https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87023 so MCP, node, and tool-result media share one boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `agent.request` opt-in with route authorization, MIME/size caps, duplicate suppression, audit/transcript receipts, and agent override or suppression rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is product/security policy across Gateway, Agents, and channel delivery, and steipete is the explicit project owner in CONTRIBUTING.
